title: On Joomla a Name left blank keeps the home title the template ships, never one made from the site address
steps: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set as in the tracy-web suite, from apps/tracy-web run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/brief-joomla.test.mjs
Read the ok/not ok line of each test named in run.tests, and the fail count.
expect: 'a Name left blank keeps the home entry title as the template ships it, whatever name stands in for it' is ok: with normalized.name 'Sqj2 03j P' and nameFrom 'label', the home entry 101 keeps page_title 'Starter Pro - Modern Joomla Template for Corporate & Business Sites' (was 'Sqj2 03j P').
"a template's own title and description in its menu entries give way to the owner's name and words, in the tidy-up's transaction" stays ok: a name the customer gave still titles the home.
Every other test of brief-joomla.test.mjs stays ok.

selectors.name: answeredName in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/shared.js, read by joomla.js (facts, category rename, menu judge, page titles)

evidence: Local stand, develop with #1297, run j2 (14/10/2026): the partial set (About given, Name blank) titled the home page 'Sqj2 0Nj P' on JA Essence, JA Impact, JA Nova and JA Vega Joomla, while their no-answer sites kept the template title.
fence: The real Joomla engine over a scratch Postgres schema with a fake site and model doubles. Not exercised: a running Joomla (the local-stand run after the rebuild).

tests: a Name left blank keeps the home entry title as the template ships it, whatever name stands in for it
a template's own title and description in its menu entries give way to the owner's name and words, in the tidy-up's transaction
